items.t: Water pump fails and leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace water pump, timing chain and tensioners
items.note: If coolant already got into the oil and damaged the bearings, a replacement engine runs $3,500-$5,500.

items.t: Brake booster fails and the pedal goes hard
items.job: Replace brake booster
items.note: Mazda's old extended warranty on this part has expired.

items.t: Sudden loss of braking
items.job: Replace brake booster or repair brake fault

items.t: Cylinder head can crack and leak coolant
items.job: Replace cylinder head assembly
items.note: If the engine overheated badly, a replacement engine can cost $6,000-$9,000.

items.t: Radiator leaks from the top
items.job: Replace radiator

items.t: Brakes wear out early
items.job: Replace front and rear brake pads and rotors

items.t: Click or squeak from the front brakes
items.job: Service front brake pads and hardware

items.t: Mazda Connect screen freezes, ghost touches or won't start
items.job: Update Mazda Connect software; replace display if needed
items.note: Software updates fix many cases. A new touchscreen is the high end.

items.t: Satellite radio resets or will not connect
items.job: Infotainment software update and antenna check

items.t: Paint flaking off
items.job: Refinish affected panel
items.note: Often covered by the corrosion or paint warranty on newer vehicles.

items.t: Creaking from the suspension
items.job: Replace sway bar bushings or strut mounts

items.t: Creak or clunk from the steering column
items.job: Tighten or replace steering column fasteners

items.t: Rattle or pop from the cowl at the base of the windshield
items.job: Retighten cowl panel bolts

items.t: Low oil warning with code P250F
items.job: Diagnose oil level sensor and update software

items.t: Battery runs down when the seat ventilation is left on
items.job: Test and replace 12-volt battery

items.t: Power liftgate opens by itself
items.job: Diagnose and repair power liftgate control

items.t: A/C weak because outside temperature reads too low
items.job: Replace ambient temperature sensor or update software

items.t: Seat heater overheats
items.job: Replace seat heater element or control
items.note: Should be covered under warranty on a newer vehicle.

items.t: Brake pedal sinks or braking feels weak
items.job: Diagnose and repair brake hydraulic fault
items.note: Should be covered under warranty on a newer vehicle.

items.t: Power steering thud or loss of assist
items.job: Repair electric power steering
items.note: Should be covered under warranty on a newer vehicle.

items.t: Repeated vehicle malfunction alerts
items.job: Module software updates and battery test

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator
items.note: Free under recall 17V-429 and related. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front lower ball joints can corrode and separate (recall)
items.job: Replace both front lower control arms
items.note: Free under recall 15V-451. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power seat wiring can short (recall)
items.job: Repair and secure seat wiring harness
items.note: Free under recall 09V-066. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Light bulb socket harness melts
items.job: Replace bulb socket and pigtail

items.t: Sunroof leaks water
items.job: Clear and reattach sunroof drain tubes

items.t: Seat heater can overheat in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Repair seat heater control
items.note: Free under recall 10V-051. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front strut bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Retighten or replace front strut bolts
items.note: Free under recall 16V-203. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 21V-875. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wiring connector fault can disable airbag or starting (recall)
items.job: Repair wiring harness connectors
items.note: Free under recall 19V-403. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire tread can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace affected tires
items.note: Free under recall 19V-770. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Second-row seat can slide forward in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace second-row seat track parts
items.note: Free under recall 21V-750. Check the VIN first.
